$comment: Hearthmere's own dialogue. The seven villagers, the mother and the Ashes all live in data/dialogue/common.json because they were written before this file existed and because loadDialogueFor MERGES BY KEY -- a map file that repeats a key replaces the whole chain for it, storm variants and all -- so nothing in here may share a name with an entry in there. What is here is the two people who only exist for one scene each, and the roofer.

lines: I am not coming down. I have been up here since six and I am not coming down for anybody.
...So that is me shouting it off a roof, which is the best you are getting out of me.
Go on. She has been out on that step since four and she thinks nobody noticed.
Twenty-one slates off in one night and eleven of them came down in Nell's garden unbroken.
Which is this village all over. I have been up here since six and had four cups of tea sent up.
Mind your head. I have dropped two things this morning and neither of them was on purpose.
In. Now. Before I start that again.
No, after you. It is your gate.
I have been waiting on it for ten minutes and I can wait another ten. Watch me.
